orientation: RPI axial; display top is anterior
representative_policy: median V5 hybrid held-out voxel accuracy
improvement_policy: V5 hybrid voxel accuracy at least 1 percentage point above the best of V2-V4
failure_focus_policy: Each shown slice contains a V2-V4 error and is selected to show either a correct V5 gate decision or a V5 gate abstention resolved by both learned outputs.
